messages:
nora: Heads-up: client Meridian requests final cutover moved from 2026-04-05 22:00 UTC to 2026-04-05 20:00 UTC due to their blackout window. Need to confirm we can re-schedule deploybot and KMS window. @infra-scheduler @ops-lead

deploy-bot: (/deploy) Reschedule request received: tenant=meridian requested_by=nora new_time=2026-04-05T20:00:00Z

ops-lead: Check: Meridian has a daily key rotation at 21:30 UTC; moving earlier is fine but must ensure post-cutover rotate=false and that we have capacity for earlier window.

infra-scheduler: I can shift reservation to 19:45-21:00 UTC if approved. Need confirmation from release-coordinator to avoid conflict with other reserved jobs.

release-coordinator: Approving shift if infra-scheduler confirms no overlap with Nova customer slice. We have a Nova reservation ending 19:30 UTC. Seems safe.

nora: Confirmed. Please pin image v1.14.3 and set kms-rotate=false for cutover. We'll run KV prime at 19:50 UTC.

ops-lead: Ack. I'll be on-call and will notify pager schedule.

deploy-bot: Schedule updated: id=643001 tenant=meridian time=2026-04-05T20:00:00Z image=redwood/inference:v1.14.3 kms_rotate=false

release-coordinator: Noted. Posting updated runbook link: https://redwood-internal/ops/runbooks/meridian-cutover-2026-04-05. Keep thread open for any preflight failures.
